creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
spotify_pw = None
for c in creds:
    if c['account_name']=='spotify':
        spotify_pw = c['password']
print('spotify_pw_found', spotify_pw is not None)
print('spotify_pw', spotify_pw)
# login using user provided email
resp = apis.spotify.login(username='tr_solo@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
print(resp)
access_token = resp.get('access_token')
print('access_token_len', len(access_token) if access_token else None)

# Step 1: gather all liked songs (paginated) and extract unique artists
try:
    _ = access_token
    token_ok = True
except NameError:
    token_ok = False

if not token_ok:
    spotify_pw = None
    for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if c['account_name']=='spotify':
            spotify_pw = c['password']
    resp = apis.spotify.login(username='tr_solo@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
    access_token = resp['access_token']

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
songs_seen = 0
artist_map = {}  # id -> name

while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # Expect resp to be list on success
    if not resp:
        break
    # Defensive: if resp is dict with success/failure
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp and len(resp)==1:
        print('Error', resp)
        break
    # resp should be list of songs
    for song in resp:
        songs_seen += 1
        for a in song.get('artists', []):
            aid = a.get('id')
            aname = a.get('name')
            if aid is not None and aid not in artist_map:
                artist_map[aid] = aname
    print('page', page_index, 'songs_seen', songs_seen, 'unique_artists', len(artist_map))
    page_index += 1

print('DONE liked songs')
print('total_songs', songs_seen)
print('unique_artists', len(artist_map))
print('sample_artists', list(artist_map.items())[:10])

# <uncertainty>Need a safe way to ensure we only follow artists not already followed.</uncertainty>
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [Strategies And Workflows]: apply filters and act only on the eligible subset</playbook_cite>
# Eligible subset = artists from liked songs that are not currently followed.

artist_ids = list(artist_map.keys())

not_following = []
following_status = {}

# Check each artist's following status
for aid, aname in artist_map.items():
    st = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    # Response schema: {"following": true/false}
    is_following = st.get('following') if isinstance(st, dict) else None
    following_status[aid] = is_following
    if is_following is False:
        not_following.append({'artist_id': aid, 'name': aname})
    # If is_following is None/unknown, don't follow to avoid accidental action.

print('checked_artists', len(artist_ids))
print('following_unknown', [aid for aid, val in following_status.items() if val is None])
print('not_following_count', len(not_following))
print('not_following_list', not_following)

# <uncertainty>Unclear if any artist has unknown following status; we'll skip those.</uncertainty>
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [Strategies And Workflows]: execute actions only on items in filtered list</playbook_cite>

followed_now = []
skipped_unknown = []

for item in not_following:
    resp = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=item['artist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    # resp has success message or failure message
    ok = None
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        # assume success when no failure key; but can't know. We'll treat as ok if message doesn't look like error.
        ok = True
    if ok:
        followed_now.append(item)
    else:
        skipped_unknown.append(item)

print('followed_now_count', len(followed_now))
print('followed_now', followed_now)
print('skipped_unknown_count', len(skipped_unknown))

# <reflection>Filtered using show_artist_following and followed only the not-following artists.</reflection>
